ny = ux

p2 = (Bx + nx * hw, By + ny * hw)
p3 = (Bx - nx * hw, By - ny * hw)

    cq.Workplane("XY")

)

)

)

import cadquery as cq

# Outer funnel frustum 35.2 -> 56.6 mm  Z 0 -> 32.2
outer = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .moveTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(35.2/2, 0)
    .lineTo(56.6/2, 32.2)
    .lineTo(0, 32.2)
    .close()
    .revolve()
)

# Inner conical recess 24.2 -> 49.2 mm  Z 6.1 -> 33.2

    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .moveTo(0, 6.1)
    .lineTo(24.2/2, 6.1)
    .lineTo(49.2/2, 33.2)
    .lineTo(0, 33.2)
    .close()
    .revolve()
)

# Cylindrical spout outside, dia 16.6, Z -12.3 to 4
spout = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(16.6/2)
    .extrude(4 - (-12.3))
    .translate((0, 0, -12.3))
)

# Bore through spout into recess, dia 10.4, Z -13.3 to 7.1
bore = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(10.4/2)
    .extrude(7.1 - (-13.3))
    .translate((0, 0, -13.3))
)

# Top rim ring, inner dia 49.2, outer dia 65.2, height 3.6 on Z=32.2
rim = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(65.2/2)
    .circle(49.2/2)
    .extrude(3.6)
    .translate((0, 0, 32.2))
)

result = outer.union(spout).union(rim).cut(inner_cone).cut(bore)
```

import cadquery as cq

    .loft()

    .workplane(offset=inner_bottom_z - inner_top_z)

    .loft()
)

    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .workplane(offset=bore_bottom_z)
    .circle(bore_r)
    .extrude(bore_height)
)

# Top rim ring
rim_outer_r = 72.0 / 2
rim_inner_r = 58.4 / 2
rim_bottom_z = 38.3
rim_height = 4.7

rim_outer = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .workplane(offset=rim_bottom_z)
    .circle(rim_outer_r)
    .extrude(rim_height)
)
rim_inner = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .workplane(offset=rim_bottom_z)
    .circle(rim_inner_r)
    .extrude(rim_height)
)
rim = rim_outer.cut(rim_inner)

body = outer.union(spout).cut(inner_cone).cut(bore)
result = body.union(rim)

)

    cq.Workplane("XZ")

    .lineTo(inner_top_r, inner_top_z)
    .lineTo(0, inner_top_z)
    .close()
    .revolve(360)
)

    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(spout_r)
    .extrude(spout_h)
    .translate((0, 0, spout_bottom_z))

    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(bore_r)
    .extrude(bore_h)
    .translate((0, 0, bore_bottom_z))

# Top rim ring

)
